The Marid (blue djinns) and the Efreet (green djinns) are at war in the desert. Ally with the Marid of {wiki:Ashta'daramai|Ashta'daramai}: get a recipe book for the cook, fetch a spy's report from the enemy fortress and swap the lamp of the Efreet leader, {npc:Malor}, for a cursed one. At the end you can trade with {npc:Haroun} and {npc:Nah'Bob}, you receive 3 {item:Small Sapphire|Small Sapphires} and you can hunt Efreets and Green Djinns.
Ally with the Marid, an ancient race of djinns, to annihilate their rivals, the fearsome Efreet, and gain the eternal trust of these powerful creatures.

At the end of the quest.
Do the {wiki:To Appease the Mighty Quest|To Appease the Mighty Quest} first: it can only be done **before** you start The Djinn War and gives 20 {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins}.
Take the {item:Cheese} right in mission 2, so you do not have to go back to the green fortress.
For mission 3 go with strong friends (blockers and shooters): the green fortress has more and more Green Djinns, Efreets and Gargoyles as you go up.
1. Learning the greeting word and entering the fortress

In **Ankrahmun**, look for {npc:Melchior}, who walks the streets. Say {key:hi} and {key:word of greeting}. He teaches you the word **DJANNI'HAH**, which lets you enter either of the fortresses. To get to Ankrahmun, say {key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes} to the port captain.

North of Ankrahmun, go up the ramp **west** of the Giant Spiders hill. Head **northwest** until you find the level 30 {item:Door of Expertise} and go in. To return to Ankrahmun, do the same route in reverse: go down the ramp and head **south**.

Talk to {npc:Umar} starting with {key:DJANNI'HAH} (instead of hi). Then say {key:passage}, {key:yes} and {key:yes} again to swear loyalty to King Gabel. From here on, on later visits, just say {key:hi}.
By accepting, you choose the Marid faction forever.
Go up to the floor above and talk to the cook {npc:Bo'Ques}: {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}. He wants a cookbook of dwarven cuisine.

If you do not have the book yet, go to **Kazordoon** and talk to {npc:Maryza} in the tavern (near the depot), saying {key:hi Maryza}. Buy the {item:Cookbook} for **150 gp**. She only sells one copy per player. You get to Kazordoon on foot or by {wiki:Steamship} (for example from Cormaya, with {npc:Gurbasch}); to return to Ankrahmun, take a boat from a port (for example Venore or Thais) with {key:ankrahmun}.
Go back to {npc:Bo'Ques} and say {key:hi}, {key:cookbook} and {key:yes}. You receive 3 {item:Small Sapphire|Small Sapphires} and he tells you to talk to {npc:Fa'Hradin}.

{npc:Fa'Hradin} is on the balcony, on the same floor as Bo'Ques. Say {key:hi} and {key:mission}. He asks you to fetch the spy report they have in the green fortress (Mal'ouquah) and gives you the password **PIEDPIPER**.
You can only get in through the back door of the green fortress **after** you have this mission.
Going up the ramp next to the oasis
With the {item:Cheese} in your backpack, go up the ramp **west** of the oasis.
Going around the green fortress from the north

Instead of going west to the front door of the green fortress, follow the path **north** and go around to the back. You will go up and down some ramps and meet {creature:Lion|Lions}, {creature:Hyaena|Hyaenas}, {creature:Cobra|Cobras}, {creature:Scorpion|Scorpions} and a {creature:Wyvern}.
Go in through the back door. Kill the {creature:Hyaena|Hyaenas} and the {creature:Green Djinn} and go down the stairs. Down there are **3** {creature:Green Djinn|Green Djinns}: kill them all.
The Green Djinns cast strong spells. Bring potions and heal in time.

Talk to the rat {npc:Rata'Mari} saying {key:PIEDPIPER} **instead of** hi. Then say {key:spy report}; he asks for cheese. Say {key:spy report} again and {key:yes} to give him the {item:Cheese}. You receive the {item:Spy Report}.
Go back the same way: go up the stairs, leave through the back door and go around the fortress by the **north** to the ramp west of the oasis. From there return to the blue fortress.
Go back to {npc:Fa'Hradin} in the blue fortress and say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}. He tells you to talk to {npc:Gabel}, upstairs.
Go up to {npc:Gabel} and say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}. He wants you to fetch Fa'Hradin's lamp from the Orc King and swap it for the lamp where {npc:Malor} sleeps.

Go to {wiki:Ulderek's Rock|Ulderek's Rock} (Orc Fortress) and go down to the room of {npc:The Orc King}. To enter the chamber you need **level 40**. Ulderek's Rock is **north** of Venore and **east** of Ab'Dendriel: from Ankrahmun take the boat to Venore ({key:venore}) and walk **north**. The Orc King is 2 floors below ground level.
If you have never talked to the Orc King, when you say hi he summons {creature:Orc Warlord|Orc Warlords}, {creature:Orc Leader|Orc Leaders}, {creature:Orc Berserker|Orc Berserkers} and maybe more.
Say {key:hi} (the orcs appear) and {key:hi} again. Then say {key:lamp} and, when he asks who you want to imprison, answer {key:Malor}. You receive the {item:Gemmed Lamp}.
Safest way: throw a {item:Poison Bomb} under the Orc King, greet him twice, ask for the lamp and run.
Run from the Orc King's room and go back the same way: go up the 2 floors to the surface and return to Venore, where the port captain takes you to Ankrahmun ({key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes}).

Go back to the green fortress through the **secret entrance** (the same as in mission 2) and go up to the top floor, where {npc:Malor}'s room is. The higher you go, the more {creature:Green Djinn|Green Djinns}, {creature:Efreet|Efreets} and {creature:Gargoyle|Gargoyles} you meet.
Secret entrance to the green fortress

You can no longer escape with stairhop. Go with strong friends, always use a {item:Dwarven Ring} and consider {spell:Magic Shield|mana shield}. Knights can use exori mas, paladins exevo mas san and mages runes.

In Malor's room, stand in front of the lamp that is **on the counter next to the bed**, and use your {item:Gemmed Lamp} on it **once**. Check in the Quest Log (third mission) that *"You successfully changed..."* appears.
Going down and leaving the green fortress

Go down the same way to the secret entrance (the creatures are still there: do not count on escaping by stairhop), leave and go back by the ramp west of the oasis. Then go up to the blue fortress to talk to {npc:Gabel}.

Go back to {npc:Gabel} and say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}. From now on you can trade with {npc:Haroun} and {npc:Nah'Bob}. You can also say {key:task} to Gabel to start the Green Djinn hunting task.
Access to trading with Haroun and Nah'Bob
{npc:Nah'Bob} and {npc:Haroun} buy and sell strong equipment at good prices — that is the main reason to do this quest.
If you prefer the green faction, see the {wiki:The Djinn War - Efreet Faction|The Djinn War - Efreet Faction}. You cannot do both.
